HeadComp.description: See how much you save on customer support software with Hello by MSG91 compared to Zendesk, Intercom, Freshdesk, Zoho Desk and more.
HeadComp.keywords: hello, msg91, cost comparison, zendesk alternative, intercom alternative, freshdesk alternative, customer support pricing

CostComparisionComp.heading: Compare your support costs with | Hello
CostComparisionComp.description: Hello charges a small monthly plan plus a low per-ticket rate — with unlimited free agents. Most tools charge per agent seat. Enter your numbers to see the difference.
CostComparisionComp.footnote: Competitor figures are published list prices as of July 2026. Brazilian vendors marked (approx) are quote-only.

CostSavingBenefits.heading: Why Hello costs less as you grow
CostSavingBenefits.description: It's structural, not a discount. The more your team grows, the wider the gap gets.

cards.title: Agents are free
cards.description: Add as many support agents as you want. Hello never charges per seat — so growing your team doesn't grow your bill.

cards.title: You pay per ticket
cards.description: Your cost tracks the work actually handled, not the number of people logged in. Predictable, and tied to real volume.

cards.title: AI is built in
cards.description: Chatbots, AI replies, and automation come with the platform — not as a per-agent add-on that inflates every invoice.

PlatformComparisonCards.heading: Two different ways to price support
PlatformComparisonCards.description: Most tools bill by the seat. Hello bills by the outcome.

faqs.question: Where do the competitor prices come from?
faqs.answer: Published list prices for each tool's most comparable plan, noted at the bottom of the calculator with the date. You can adjust any figure to match the exact plan you're on.

faqs.question: Why are agents free on Hello?
faqs.answer: Hello prices per ticket handled rather than per seat. Whether you have 3 agents or 300, the platform cost is the same — you pay for conversations, not logins.

faqs.question: Does this include agent salaries?
faqs.answer: Salaries are shown for full context but kept equal on both sides, so the highlighted saving reflects software cost. You can model workload reduction separately.

faqs.question: Can I see this for Brazilian tools?
faqs.answer: Yes — Take Blip, and Zenvia are in the dropdown alongside Zendesk, Intercom, Freshdesk, Zoho Desk, and Respond.io.
